lock_policy: 锁定1/2/3/4 suppressed in the assembly as of 2026-09-19. A lock freezes the pair relative position but cannot stop the pair shapes changing when a driven dimension changes, which is what produced the measured overlaps; 锁定4 also over-defined the assembly and blocked the shaft-to-bore concentric mate.
shaft_concentric_mate: 同心54 (11蝶板 <-> 04阀轴) added 2026-09-19. Lock 4 must be suppressed first or AddMate5 returns swAddMateError_OverDefinedAssembly (5). With it the shaft follows the disc bore, so changing e or c no longer leaves the two axes delta-e apart (measured interference 1643.14 mm3 -> 0).
flow_project_policy: No Flow project is stored in this template as of 2026-09-19. The adapter discards any inherited project on every run anyway; keeping one only meant a RemoveProject call that intermittently dies with RPC_E_DISCONNECTED and fails the whole run. Projects are rebuilt from the Flow installation template internal_water.fwp plus the boundary conditions and goals defined in code.

cap_policy: The template carries NO endcaps as of 2026-09-19. The four caps used to exist only to be deleted on every run; with them came the failure mode where an inherited Flow project referencing the deleted caps raised a modal dialog. Six core parts plus the assembly is now the whole template, and Flow Create Lids builds the four lids on the capless output.
